verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents a JMAP API with a session endpoint, API tokens, and the IETF RFCs as its specification, but nothing in the evidence shows a Fastmail-published official SDK. The Rust and TypeScript libraries listed on jmap.io are implementations of the open protocol, not attributed to Fastmail. A raw API plus third-party libraries counts only as developer building blocks, not official SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
